title: Al-Razi tells smallpox from measles
summary: The Persian physician al-Razi wrote one of the earliest surviving books describing smallpox and measles as distinct diseases, alongside one by Thabit ibn Qurra.

notes.problem: Source gives birth '864 or 865' and credits Thabit ibn Qurra with a same-titled book; earlier late-antique authors also differentiated them.
